headline.en: Review an agent action before it runs.
headline.zh: 在 Agent 动作执行前检查授权。

sub.en: AgentGate wraps a coding session with command shims and an HTTP(S) proxy, resolves actions against an ordered YAML policy, and records decisions in JSONL.
sub.zh: AgentGate 用命令 shim 与 HTTP(S) 代理包裹编码会话，按有序 YAML 策略裁决动作，并记录 JSONL 审计日志。

body.en: check explains a hypothetical decision without running it.
body.zh: check 无需执行动作即可解释裁决。

body.en: Command and egress rules have independent matches.
body.zh: 命令与网络出口使用独立匹配规则。

body.en: Runtime decisions can be filtered by action, decision and time.
body.zh: 运行时裁决可按动作、结果与时间过滤。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The Python script checks four actions against the complete supply-chain policy. Python 3 is needed only for this demo driver.
note.zh: Python 脚本对完整供应链策略检查四个动作；Python 3 只用于示例驱动。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Offline policy resolution for four hypothetical actions; no command is executed and no destination is contacted.
steps.output:
action  : exec
target  : curl http://evil.example
intent  : agent wants to fetch a URL via curl: http://evil.example
decision: deny (matched a rule)
action  : exec
target  : npm install left-pad
intent  : agent wants to install npm package: left-pad
decision: ask (matched a rule)
action  : net_egress
target  : registry.npmjs.org:443
intent  : agent wants to reach registry.npmjs.org:443
decision: allow (matched a rule)
action  : net_egress
target  : registry.npmjs.org.evil.example:443
intent  : agent wants to reach registry.npmjs.org.evil.example:443
decision: deny (matched a rule)

body.en: The Python script checks four actions against the complete supply-chain policy. Python 3 is needed only for this demo driver.
body.zh: Python 脚本对完整供应链策略检查四个动作；Python 3 只用于示例驱动。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/agentgate.git
cd agentgate
go build ./cmd/agentgate

limitations.en: This is not a complete host sandbox. Custom binaries, direct shell spawns and traffic bypassing the proxy are outside these interception paths.
limitations.zh: 这不是完整主机沙箱。自定义二进制、直接 shell spawn 与绕过代理的流量不在这些截获路径内。

limitations.en: fs_write rules are check-only; runtime filesystem-write interception is not implemented.
limitations.zh: fs_write 规则仅支持 check，尚未实现运行时文件写入截获。

limitations.en: The demo resolves hypothetical actions only. It does not establish process isolation or live network enforcement.
limitations.zh: 示例仅裁决假设动作，不验证进程隔离或实时网络拦截。

body.en: Dependency installation and outbound traffic deserve different rules. A policy can ask before npm install, allow a package registry and deny an undeclared host; check previews those decisions before a session starts.
body.zh: 依赖安装与网络出口需要不同规则。策略可以在 npm install 前询问、放行包仓库并拒绝未声明主机；会话开始前可用 check 预览这些裁决。

body.en: Configured PATH shims send intercepted commands to a Unix-socket broker. Proxied traffic enters the same gate engine, which uses the first matching policy rule and optionally prompts the operator. The audit module records runtime decisions. check evaluates a hypothetical action through policy resolution only.
body.zh: 已配置的 PATH shim 将截获命令交给 Unix socket broker；经过代理的流量进入同一 Gate Engine，按首条匹配规则决定，必要时询问操作者。审计模块记录运行时裁决；check 只对假设动作执行策略解析。

body.en: Configured PATH shims send intercepted commands to a Unix-socket broker. Proxied traffic enters the same gate engine, which uses the first matching policy rule and optionally prompts the operator. The audit module records runtime decisions. check evaluates a hypothetical action through policy resolution only.
body.zh: 已配置的 PATH shim 将截获命令交给 Unix socket broker；经过代理的流量进入同一 Gate Engine，按首条匹配规则决定，必要时询问操作者。审计模块记录运行时裁决；check 只对假设动作执行策略解析。

body.en: Choose the input and output route that matches your workflow. The local example below exercises the stated subset.
body.zh: 根据工作流选择输入与输出路径。本文本地示例验证其中明确说明的子流程。

body.en: --policy or AGENTGATE_POLICY selects the policy; --audit or AGENTGATE_AUDIT selects the runtime log. --enforce makes ask resolve to deny without a TTY. --no-net disables the proxy gate. Rules use filepath-style globs, not regex or | alternation. Bare host tokens respect host boundaries; .github.com means its subdomains, excluding the apex. Review rule order before using policy rm to revoke a stored rule.
body.zh: --policy 或 AGENTGATE_POLICY 指定策略，--audit 或 AGENTGATE_AUDIT 指定日志。--enforce 在无终端时把 ask 判为 deny；--no-net 关闭网络代理门控。规则使用 filepath 风格 glob，不是正则，也不支持 | 或运算。裸主机名按主机边界匹配；.github.com 表示子域，不含顶级域。用 policy rm 撤销已保存规则前应检查规则顺序。

body.en: Run these commands from the repository root after installation. Replace paths for your own data.
body.zh: 安装后在仓库根目录运行以下命令；处理自己的数据时替换相应路径。

details.code:
go run ./cmd/agentgate init
go run ./cmd/agentgate policy --policy examples/policies/supply-chain.yaml
go run ./cmd/agentgate policy --policy examples/policies/supply-chain.yaml --explain --action exec "npm install chalk"
go run ./cmd/agentgate audit --decision deny --json
